summary: This video covers the Dragonheir 3rd Anniversary event running from September 2 to October 1, 2026. The event is split into three main phases: Prelude to Nightfall, First Glimpse of Fate, and Gift of Fate. Players can unlock daily story chapters and roll dice for materials, invite friends, and take daily quizzes across four scenes. Progressing through the event grants access to a random SSR Fate Hero from a preset pool with chances to reselect, along with a gift draw pool featuring an R-Legendary Hero Option Chest.
tips: Make sure to log in during the Prelude to Nightfall phase (Sep 2 - Sep 9) to complete the daily prologue story chapters and roll dice for extra Wyrmarrow, Scholar Scrolls, and Auric Tokens.

During the First Glimpse of Fate phase (Sep 9 - Sep 15), enter all 4 story scenes and answer quizzes; entering a new scene provides a chance to reselect your Fate Hero if you dislike your current random roll.
Complete the First Glimpse of Fate to qualify for the Gift of Fate draw pool, aiming for the Tier A R-Legendary Hero Option Chest to select a legendary hero directly.
